artworks.title: The Sacrifice of Abraham
artworks.artist: Battista Franco
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two male figures, one kneeling and the other standing with a knife. An angel hovers above them, reaching one hand downwards. A ram stands to the left, looking towards the figures. The background features a large tree with a draped cloth and swirling clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: Genius with the Medici Coat-of-Arms
artworks.artist: Cherubino Alberti
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged cherub holding a sphere and flowers. The cherub is in flight, surrounded by flowing drapery and ribbons. The cherub has detailed feathered wings and is poised in motion with its right arm uplifted, holding a round orb with fleur-de-lis symbols. The left hand of the cherub clasps a bouquet of leafy branches. A ribbon with the inscription "POLO FLORESCERE DIGNA" unfurls around the scene. Detailed line work creates a sense of motion and texture in this classical representation.

artworks.title: Orpheus and Eurydice
artworks.artist: Gaetano Gandolfi
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on tan laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals from head to toe. The figure on the left is in a defensive or startled position, leaning backward with one arm raised to touch their head. The second figure, slightly behind the first, is in motion, with one arm cradling the first figure's chest and their head turned upward. Both individuals have detailed facial features and wavy hair. They are wearing flowing garments, with one figure's garment slipping from their shoulder. A chunky, curved instrument is on the ground. The background shows rocky and cave-like formations, enhancing the interaction between the figures.

artworks.title: The Artist's Wife and Daughters in a Park at Heringsdorf
artworks.artist: Anton von Werner
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on cardboard
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Alexander M. and Judith W. Laughlin
artworks.description: The image shows a woodland area with tall trees dominating the vertical space. A woman in a blue and white striped garment is interacting with a figure near a basket on a cart. Another woman stands with a child in blue, and a child is sitting on the ground playing. The trees have detailed foliage and textured bark. The color palette consists of earthy browns, vibrant greens, and pops of blue and white. The scene conveys a peaceful day in the park, with sunlight casting shadows on the path and grassy patches.

artworks.title: Studies of Screwpines from Madagascar
artworks.artist: Max Seliger
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with white heightening on gray cardboard
artworks.description: This illustration features a large plant with long, arching leaves dominating the center, sprawling outwards with detailed line work. The color palette is monochromatic, using black ink on a gray background. Positioned on the left is a dense cluster of foliage, while to the right, a smaller plant with spiky fronds stands upright. Several handwritten notes surround the plants, providing additional visual texture to the image.

artworks.title: Rock Cliffs above a Stream
artworks.artist: Johann Christoph Erhard
artworks.description: The image shows a vertical view of a rocky cliff with various levels of vegetation. The cliff dominates the scene, with no clear horizon visible due to its towering presence. Vegetation is seen on the rock surfaces, with more trees growing from crevices and the base. The artwork features detailed pencil strokes and shading, depicting the texture of the rocks and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, using different shades of gray. Large boulders are seen close to the base of the cliff, with the cliff continuing to rise unevenly in the background.

artworks.title: Elegant Young Woman in Classical Drapery
artworks.artist: Otto Greiner
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white and gold on green paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a pencil and chalk drawing of a partially visible person. The figure is shown seated in a twisting pose, with arms extended and head turned slightly. The facial features are detailed, with a serene expression and hair styled loosely. The figure wears flowing robes with textured folds. Another drawing of the person's head is shown to the right, with the same expression and hairstyle. The background is a solid grayish-green color. White chalk is used for highlighting details.

artworks.title: Haystack
artworks.artist: William Henry Fox Talbot
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up view of a large haystack with a ladder leaning against its side. The scene focuses on the structure of dried straw and the ladder, which is oriented diagonally towards the top of the haystack. The haystack is constructed with visible layers of straw that appear dense and textured. The palette is mainly sepia tones, creating an antique appearance and emphasizing the contrast between light and shadow. Behind the haystack, blurry figures suggest trees, adding to the timeless quality of the scene.

artworks.title: Forbury Hill, Reading
artworks.artist: Attributed to Nicolaas Henneman
artworks.description: The image shows a group of leafless trees and a small building with a bell tower on the right side. The structure appears elevated on a small hill with a fence along the top. Sparse foliage suggests a winter or late autumn setting.

artworks.title: David Octavius Hill at the gate of Rock House, Edinburgh
artworks.artist: David Octavius Hill and Robert Adamson
artworks.dimensions:
image/sheet: 19.6 x 13.8 cm (7 11/16 x 5 7/16 in.)
framed: 50.8 x 43.2 cm (20 x 17 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing against a textured stone wall. He faces the camera with a serious expression, showcasing his strong jawline and dark wavy hair. He wears a dark suit with a high-collared white shirt and clasps his hands together while holding a thin object. A round object is mounted on the wall beside him, and the background is in deep shadow.

artworks.title: Afghan or Circassian Armour
artworks.artist: David Octavius Hill and Robert Adamson

artworks.title: Patrick Boyle Mure Macredie
artworks.artist: David Octavius Hill and Robert Adamson
artworks.description: The image shows a man depicted from the waist up. He is seated and leaning slightly forward, with his right hand resting over his left forearm and the fingers of his left hand curled inward. His facial features include a strong jawline, prominent cheekbones, and a focused expression. He has dark hair that appears slightly tousled and unevenly cut. The man is dressed in a dark buttoned coat with a high collar, and it seems that he wears a white shirt underneath, partially visible at the collar. The coat has noticeable buttons that are reflective. There is no visible jewelry, and he is not holding any objects. The background is a simple, abstract surface which includes a fabric with a subtle, likely plaid pattern.

artworks.title: John Stuart-Wortley, 2nd Baron Wharncliffe
artworks.artist: David Octavius Hill and Robert Adamson
artworks.description: The image depicts an upper-body portrait of a seated man looking to his left. He has wavy hair combed back, with sideburns. His face features a straight nose and a strong jawline. The man is dressed in formal attire: a dark suit, vest, high-collared white shirt, and a dark cravat. His left hand rests on his lap, and his right hand holds a small rectangular book on his knee. The background is a simple, dark backdrop with part of an elaborately carved chair visible.

artworks.title: James Archer
artworks.artist: David Octavius Hill and Robert Adamson
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a seated contemplative pose. His eyes are closed, and he has one hand on his face and the other on his lap. He has medium-length wavy hair, is wearing a dark suit with a white shirt and a bow tie. The background shows an upholstered chair and an ornate textured surface. The image has a sepia tone.

artworks.title: William McNab
artworks.artist: David Octavius Hill and Robert Adamson
artworks.description: The image shows a seated man from the waist up, positioned slightly sideways but looking directly at the camera. He has high cheekbones, short, thinning hair, and a firm expression. The man is wearing a dark-colored coat over a shirt with a high collar and a cravat. A shirt cuff is visible at the edge of his sleeve. He is holding a small object between his fingers. In the background, there are wooden structures or branches.

artworks.title: Prayer
artworks.artist: David Octavius Hill and Robert Adamson

artworks.title: Rev Ebenezer Miller and family
artworks.artist: David Octavius Hill and Robert Adamson
artworks.description: The image shows a group of four people. Three women and one man are present. The oldest woman, sitting in the center, wears a bonnet with lace details and a dark dress. She has a calm expression. A younger woman stands behind her. A child stands to the left, leaning on the older woman. On the right, the man is seated at a small ornate table with his hand on a book, wearing a dark formal suit with a white shirt and cravat. The background appears textured, possibly a patterned fabric or wallpaper. The photograph has a sepia tone.

artworks.title: The Castle, St Andrews
artworks.artist: David Octavius Hill and Robert Adamson
artworks.description: The image shows a rugged coastal landscape with a stone structure resembling a tower or fortification on the left. The stone appears weathered and aged. Rocky formations and ruins stretch along the coastline to the right, leading to the sea on the horizon. The sea forms a wide separation between the land and the sky. The image is in a sepia tone, giving it an aged appearance. The scene is barren and detailed, with warm brown and cream colors emphasizing its historical feel.

artworks.title: Lady Glenorchy's Chapel during demolition, on the site of Waverley Station
artworks.artist: David Octavius Hill and Robert Adamson
artworks.description: The image shows a sepia-toned photograph of a brick building under construction or renovation. The viewer seems to be slightly higher, looking at the building from a small incline. The structure has large windows, some with protective brickwork or scaffolding, and a round vent or window above the central archway. In the foreground, a man sits on a stone ledge surrounded by construction materials. To the right, the scene extends to show more of the building and a leafless tree. The color palette is warm and brown, typical of early photography techniques.

artworks.title: Colinton Manse and weir, with part of the old mill on the right
artworks.artist: David Octavius Hill and Robert Adamson
artworks.description: The image depicts a large house surrounded by trees with a waterfall in the foreground. The house is built of light stone and partially obscured by trees. The waterfall flows over rocks with a soft blur effect. The image has a grainy texture and warm sepia tones, giving it a nostalgic feel.

artworks.title: Linlithgow, from the railway station, with the Town Hall, St. Michael's Church, and Palace
artworks.artist: David Octavius Hill and Robert Adamson
artworks.description: The image shows a town with various buildings and rooftops, including a large church or cathedral with towers. The scene features a dense arrangement of buildings, stone paths, and roads. The overall tone of the image is sepia, creating an antique look reminiscent of early photography techniques.

artworks.title: At the Minnow Pool
artworks.artist: David Octavius Hill and Robert Adamson
artworks.description: The image shows three children outdoors. One boy is sitting on a rock, holding a stick. Another child is partially obscured behind him. A girl is leaning on the rocks, wearing a dress. A basket is on the grass beside the rock. The background is blurred with dark foliage or trees.

artworks.title: Alexander Rutherford, William Ramsay and John Linton
artworks.artist: David Octavius Hill and Robert Adamson
artworks.description: Three men are shown waist up to their feet. They are standing close together with one resting an elbow on the shoulder of another, and another with his arm on his hip. Their facial features are not clearly visible. All three are wearing hats: two have round-brimmed hats and one has a tall, cylindrical hat. They have dark and untamed hair under the hats. The men wear dark jackets, light-colored trousers, and scarves or kerchiefs around their necks. They are not wearing any visible jewelry or holding objects. The background is blurry, likely showing a rustic outdoor setting with a wooden structure or landscape in the background. The image has a sepia tone.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.artist: British 19th Century
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated outdoors next to a stone structure supporting a bust sculpture. He is positioned slightly to the left of the sculpture, leaning over a flat stone surface with an open book in front of him. The man has a well-groomed hairstyle with hair parted to the side and is wearing a suit with a high-collared shirt and a dark tie. There are no visible accessories. In the background are trees and foliage, giving the scene a garden-like setting, and a branch is visible in the upper left corner. The overall tone of the image is soft and subdued.
